	local savedScroll = ListFrame.CanvasPosition

	for _, child in ipairs(ListFrame:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextButton") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	table.clear(playerButtons)

	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
			local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
			btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 30)
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 52, 62)
			btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
			btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
			btn.TextSize = 12
			btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			btn.Parent = ListFrame

			btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				togglePlayerSelection(plr)
			end)

			playerButtons[plr] = btn
		end
	end

	refreshButtonHighlights()
	ListFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 6)
	ListFrame.CanvasPosition = savedScroll
end

-- Кнопка Пин
PinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isPinned = not isPinned
	MainFrame.Draggable = not isPinned
	if isPinned then
		PinBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 115, 210)
	else
		PinBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 52, 64)
	end
end)

-- Кнопка Свернуть (-)
MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isMinimized = not isMinimized
	if isMinimized then
		MainFrame.Size = COLLAPSED_SIZE
		PowerFrame.Visible = false
		DistFrame.Visible = false
		PosGrid.Visible = false
		ListFrame.Visible = false
		MinBtn.Text = "+"
	else
		MainFrame.Size = EXPANDED_SIZE
		PowerFrame.Visible = true
		DistFrame.Visible = true
		PosGrid.Visible = true
		ListFrame.Visible = true
		MinBtn.Text = "-"
	end
end)

-- Кнопка Закрыть (❌)
CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local wasEnabled = enabled
	alive = false
	enabled = false
	table.clear(selectedPlayers)
	if wasEnabled then
		recoverCharacterFromGround()
	end
	for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
		if conn.Connected then
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
	end
	if ScreenGui and ScreenGui.Parent then
		ScreenGui:Destroy()
	end
end)

-- Кнопка "Вкл" (работает даже если целей 0)
OnBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	cleanupInvalidPlayers()
	if #selectedPlayers > 0 and (not activeTarget or not table.find(selectedPlayers, activeTarget)) then
		activeTarget = selectedPlayers[1]
	end
	enabled = true
	updateStatusUI()
end)

-- Кнопка "Выкл"
OffBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	enabled = false
	updateStatusUI()
	recoverCharacterFromGround()
end)

table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait(0.1)
	if alive then
		rebuildPlayerList()
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
	local idx = table.find(selectedPlayers, plr)
	if idx then
		table.remove(selectedPlayers, idx)
	end
	if activeTarget == plr then
		activeTarget = selectedPlayers[1]
	end
	if alive then
		rebuildPlayerList()
	end
end))

-- Автообновление списка игроков каждые 1 секунду
task.spawn(function()
	while alive do
		task.wait(1)
		if alive then
			rebuildPlayerList()
		end
	end
end)

-- Цикл переключения между выбранными игроками (по 2 сек на каждого)
task.spawn(function()
	while alive do
		if enabled and #selectedPlayers >= 2 then
			local index = 1
			while alive and enabled and #selectedPlayers >= 2 do
				cleanupInvalidPlayers()
				if #selectedPlayers < 2 then
					break
				end
				if index > #selectedPlayers then
					index = 1
				end
				local candidate = selectedPlayers[index]
				if candidate and candidate.Parent then
					activeTarget = candidate
					task.wait(2)
				end
				index += 1
			end
		else
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end
end)

-- Постоянное удержание в выбранной позиции и обновление дистанции в кнопках
table.insert(connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not alive then
		return
	end

	if not isMinimized and ListFrame.Visible then
		for plr, btn in pairs(playerButtons) do
			if plr and plr.Parent and btn and btn.Parent then
				btn.Text = formatPlayerButtonText(plr)
			end
		end
	end

	if not enabled then
		return
	end

	cleanupInvalidPlayers()

	if #selectedPlayers == 0 then
		activeTarget = nil
		return
	end

	if #selectedPlayers == 1 then
		activeTarget = selectedPlayers[1]
	elseif not activeTarget or not activeTarget.Parent or not table.find(selectedPlayers, activeTarget) then
		activeTarget = selectedPlayers[1]
	end

	teleportToTarget(activeTarget)
end))

rebuildPlayerList()
